batch: Classify four complete researcher-supplied Brill corpus editions
policy: These are document-scope judgments based on complete-volume inspection. They do not endorse individual readings, make identity decisions, or approve public reuse of copyrighted text or images.

entries.basis: Complete researcher-supplied volume, archive SHA-256 39a876337301.... It publishes JBA 1-64 as full editions with object descriptions, transcriptions, translations, commentary, photographs, and indexes.

Complete researcher-supplied volume, archive SHA-256 e15f96f25da9.... It publishes JBA 65-119 as full editions with object descriptions, transcriptions, translations, commentary, photographs, and indexes.

Complete researcher-supplied volume, archive SHA-256 ce32170d182d.... It systematically re-edits 49 previously published Syriac incantation bowls and includes descriptions, transcriptions, translations, commentary, photographs or facsimiles, and indexes.

Complete researcher-supplied volume, archive SHA-256 23431f46510c.... It catalogues the Frau Professor Hilprecht Collection: forty legible Aramaic bowl texts receive full editions and the remaining fragmentary, non-Aramaic, pseudoscript, uninscribed, or non-bowl material receives descriptions and photographs.
